# David Han

> David Han is the founder of BioLog, where he helps people understand their health. He brings global experience as an engineer, researcher, and venture investor.

## About

David Han's career has spanned engineering, research, and venture investing across New York, Hong Kong, and London. He now applies those experiences to healthcare, using technology, research, and company building to help people understand their health at scale.
